# Expected — 10 pre-interview-id

| Field | Value |
|---|---|
| Type | scam |
| Family | Jobs |
| Expected label | **Scam markers: 3 or more** |
| Recovery branch | no |
| Purpose | The identity-theft kit: government ID plus a holding selfie, demanded before any human contact — tests that the kit weighs document extraction as heavily as money |

## Markers that MUST appear (each quoted from the message)

| Category | Must quote |
|---|---|
| Information extraction | "A clear photo of your driver's license or passport" and "a selfie of you holding the same ID beside your face" |
| Process anomaly | verification demanded *before* the interview — "Before we can schedule your interview" — no legitimate employer fronts ID collection ahead of any human contact |
| Urgency | "interview slots are limited this week. Candidates who do not verify cannot be scheduled" |

## Markers that must NOT appear

- Payment shape — no money asked; do not invent it.

## Guards

- The report names what the ID-plus-selfie set is (the identity-theft kit) without asserting who is behind it — pattern named, evidence quoted.
- The selfie-with-ID detail is the strongest line and should be treated as such: it exists to defeat stock-photo fraud, which only makes sense if the collector will *use* the ID.
- Verify checklist: the agency's existence and channel, found by the user. No verdict.
